economic_hypothesis: In a causally known broad BULL state and healthy industry, a true upward no-trade interval is a discrete information repricing. A close in the upper 30% of the signal bar on at least 1.5x preceding turnover is same-day demand acceptance; the next legal open tests whether repricing continues.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
industry: same-day median ret20>0 and positive-ret20 share>50%

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R4_GAP_GE_1PCT_LOW_EXTENSION: base, gap width>=1%, and pre-signal ret20<=15%

signal.acceptance: close>=open and close location in bar>=70%
signal.freshness: no prior true-up gap in preceding 20 completed symbol sessions
signal.true_up_gap: QD-010 coord_low_t > coord_high_t-1 on consecutive sessions
